race.description: Terminus Hotel/Dubbo City Toyota Showcase Hcp (C2)
race.comment: Tough race to close the day. FEARN TRICK (4) never headed when saluting two back over this trip at Wellington. Never on the track from the wide barrier with a fading last over 1000m at Dubbo. Back to her pet trip from a better gate. Top three contender. KEVIN (3) comes out of a fast run contest after shouldering the 59kg with a fading fifth to Puffin over this trip at Dubbo. Has good early speed so should take up a forward position. Don't underestimate. ENCHAANTED (10) surprised at the good odds when she used the rails draw to her benefit with a game on speed win over 1000m at Dubbo. Can surprise again over the extra trip. STAR WHISPERER (5) lightly raced gelding struggling to draw a decent barrier. Chipped away late in C3 grade when sixth over 950m at Moree. Kept fresh and can run into the placings.
